title: Car crash outside the Dark Skies office: dying man's life flashes through Brent
place_text: Dark Skies production office, North Hollywood

tellings.quote: and in that moment I feel all of his energy go through my body like his soul

plain: In the 1990s, a car crashed outside the North Hollywood office of Dark Skies, a television production, and as a man lay dying, a writer named Brent Friedman says he felt the man's whole life pass through him. Friedman, who was there, says, "I feel all of his energy go through my body like his soul." He tells it as a personal brush with something beyond the ordinary.
